title: Etiquette And Examples (Michelle Grogan)
style: soft rock bongo trance earthy fusion 130bpm acoustic guitar bongo conga marimba shakers warm bass synth pads tribal claps happy chorus English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Etiquette is the heart of the game
Respect the players respect the court
Simple rules to play with grace
Make every match a happy place

[Verse 1]
Call the score loud before the serve
Server says it twice for sure
Return the ball after the point
Dont fire it back to annoy joint
Vamos vamos respect ready
Uno dos tres voice steady
If the ball rolls onto your court
Return it gently in good sport

[Pre-Chorus]
Knock knock paddle
Good game good game
Knock knock paddle
No blame no blame

[Chorus]
Etiquette and examples etiquette and examples
Respect the court respect the partner
Etiquette and examples etiquette and examples
Vamos amigos play with karma

[Verse 2]
If you hit the ball off the court
Apologize and walk in short
If they hit a winner say great shot
Not a sigh and not a dot
Uno dos tres after match
Mano blanda paddle latch
Tap paddles at the net for thanks
Good game good game pull no pranks

[Bridge]
Dont coach uninvited from the side
Dont call lines on their court hide
Make your call on your side only
Be humble never lonely

[Chorus]
Etiquette and examples etiquette and examples
Respect the court respect the partner
Etiquette and examples etiquette and examples
Vamos amigos play with karma

[Outro]
Knock knock paddle
Good game good game
Knock knock paddle
No blame no blame
